:::{#def-complement}
#### Complement of an event

The **complement** of an [event](#def-event) $A$, denoted $\neg A$,
is the event that $A$ does not [occur](#def-occurs):
the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-set) of elements $\omega$ of the [sample space](#def-sample-space) $\samplespace$ that are not in $A$:

$$\neg A \eqdef \setbuild{\omega \in \samplespace}{\omega \notin A}$$

:::
